title: Bridge and Atlas
author: Hazel Ishikawa
blurb: Casper Oyelaran, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
